messages.author: 8c6b85a01a12e3e2
messages.subject: Specify custom precision matrix?
parts:
Is there a way to specify a custom precision matrix in INLA? 

For example, say I have a BYM model precision matrix with row around the diagonal of [..... 0, -1, -1, 4, -1, -1, 0 ...] and I want to weight one of the neighbors twice [..... 0, -1, -2, 5, -1, -1, 0 ...].   Is there a way to specify this non-standard precision matrix directly?  I can imagine doing something hacky with variable duplication, but that would get unwieldy very quickly and my intuition is counting the same data twice isn't equivalent to weighting the data once.

Thanks. I'm new to INLA and GMRFs, so I appreciate your help!

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Specify custom precision matrix?
parts:
Hi,

there are various types of generic models, see

inla.doc("generic")

and you might find yours there.


as a last resort, you can also define an f() model using R (see
inla.doc("rgeneric"))

H
